instructions_to_main_agent: Build a polished responsive marketing landing page for FocusNest using React, Tailwind CSS, and Lucide icons. Implement navigation with anchors, hero section with high-impact CTAs and live focus mockup, interactive feature tabs/cards, 3-step 'How It Works' workflow, student social proof testimonials, simple Free vs Pro pricing tables, final CTA, and a complete responsive footer. Adhere strictly to the crisp white, cobalt blue, and graphite color palette with generous spacing, glassmorphism headers, and accessibility standards with data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App text-align center).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
You have .js files not .tsx file, share guidelines for .js files.
